provenance.pins: two-terminal TVS, DO-214AC/SOD outline: pin 1 = cathode-band end, pin 2 = opposite. Polarity from the package drawing, not inferred from function

notes: H5VL10B, DFN1006-2L, 12.9M stock, $0.0065. Low-capacitance ESD clamp for USB D+/D-, the CC lines, and the two WS2812 data outputs.
Low capacitance matters on D+/D- (USB 2.0 full speed) and on an 800 kbps WS2812 line driven down metres of cable. A general-purpose TVS would load both.
SCOPE CORRECTED: used on USB-C D+/D- and CC1/CC2 only. The output pairs are differential and carry SMAJ7.0CA (C19077529), not this part.
